units.source_text: 八月十日的头天晚上，月色清亮。

en.t: On the evening before August tenth, the moonlight was clear and bright.

units.source_text: 十日早晨，灿烂的阳光、鲜明的影子、淡淡的白云，下这盘棋以来第一次遇上这样好的仲夏天气。

en.t: On the morning of the tenth, there was brilliant sunlight, sharply defined shadows, and faint white clouds; since this game had begun, it was the first time they had such fine midsummer weather.

units.source_text: 合欢树也纵情地展开叶子。

en.t: The silk trees, too, spread their leaves to their fullest.

units.source_text: 大竹七段那短外褂上的白色结带，清楚地映现在眼前。

en.t: The white tying cords on Otake Seventh Dan's short haori stood out clearly before one's eyes.

units.source_text: 名人夫人说：“不过，天气稳定下来倒是好的。”

en.t: The Meijin's wife said, "Still, it is good that the weather has settled down."

units.source_text: 可是她的面容突然变得消瘦了。

en.t: But her face had suddenly grown thin and gaunt.

units.source_text: 大竹夫人睡眠不足，气色也不佳。

en.t: Mrs. Otake was short of sleep, and her complexion was poor as well.

units.source_text: 两位夫人的脸枯干憔悴，闪烁着不安的目光，

en.t: The faces of the two wives were dry and haggard, their eyes flickering with unease,

units.source_text: 她们为各自的丈夫操心劳神，急得团团转。

en.t: each of them worried and exhausted over her own husband, beside herself with anxiety.

units.source_text: 可以看出，她们都表现了各自的利己主义。

en.t: It could be seen that each of them revealed her own selfishness.
